provenance.paper_title: Memory-Augmented Vision-Language Agents for Persistent and Semantically Consistent Object Captioning

evidence.paraphrase: A top-down explored map grounds current RGB observations in persistent spatial context.
Serialized object tokens preserve identity and caption history across viewpoints and extended sequences.

The autoregressive agent jointly updates object association, captions, and episodic object state. For Memory-Augmented Object Captioning Agent, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of explored top-down map.

Multi-view history is used to maintain persistent identity and correct inconsistent object descriptions. For Memory-Augmented Object Captioning Agent, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of explored top-down map.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (explored top-down map) changes through a trained but frozen update module, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
